First build of the Mac companion app.

**Install on the Mac**
1. Download `iPad-Mouse-mac-0.1.0.zip` below and unzip it.
2. Move `iPad Mouse.app` to your Applications folder and open it.
3. This build is not notarized, so macOS refuses the first launch. Open System Settings > Privacy & Security, scroll down, click **Open Anyway**, then open the app again.
4. When asked, allow iPad Mouse under Accessibility (called Device Control and Data Access on newer macOS).
5. Open iPad Mouse on the iPad. The Mac shows an "Allow this iPad?" dialog: click Allow.

The Mac app starts at login from then on. The iPad app is installed from Xcode for now; see the README.
